slides.body: Two people can have the same planet in the same sign and live it very differently. Panchadha Maitri helps explain part of why.
Each planet has natural friends, neutrals and enemies. It also forms temporary friendships based on how planets sit in your own chart.
Combine the two and you get five grades: great friend, friend, neutral, enemy and great enemy. This grade shows how comfortable a planet is.
This is one factor among many. Houses, aspects and dasha all shape the outcome. No single rule decides a life.
Free Planet Friendship Check: see each planet's grade in your chart.
